description: This file implements the logic for a web-based Tic-Tac-Toe game, including player initialization, game state management, UI updates, and event handling.
external_files: HTML elements with classes 'gamecell', 'names-dialog', 'result-dialog', and elements like 'main button', 'main p', etc.

classes.name: Player
classes.description: Factory function creating player objects with name and symbol accessors.

methods.name: gameInitialization
methods.description: Initializes the game, setting up game board, display controller, and game logic.

methods.name: gameBoard
methods.description: Encapsulates game board state and logic for checking winner, tie, and managing the board array.

methods.name: displayController
methods.description: Handles UI updates such as showing dialogs, updating titles, and clearing the game board.

methods.name: makePlayerMove
methods.description: Handles a player's move, updating UI and game state.

methods.name: processGameResult
methods.description: Checks for game end conditions: win or tie, and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: changePlayerTurn
methods.description: Switches the current player and updates the UI title.

methods.name: doPlayerTurn
methods.description: Handles a player's turn when a cell is clicked, including move validation and game result processing.

methods.name: cleanGame
methods.description: Resets the game state and UI for a new game.
